name: Sponsor
source:
The Sponsor is a minor antagonist in The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy-. They are the main antagonist of the Killing Game Route.

They have multiple identities, [url=https://vndb.org/c162194]Kako-G[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c150821]Eito Aotsuki[/url] as well as a third unidentified form.
